svg.data-renderer: Matplotlib MathText / STIX; embedded vector paths
svg.title: Signs of a planar orientation determinant
svg.desc: Horizontal coordinates increase left to right and the y-axis points upward. The middle point lies below the endpoint line in the positive case and above it in the negative case.
Figure labels: Positive determinant; Negative determinant; x; y; P₁; P₂; P₃; P₂ below P₁P₃; Δ > 0; x; y; P₁; P₂; P₃; P₂ above P₁P₃; Δ < 0
